final_operational.failed: The first post-evidence clean-state probe combined an index check with a full untracked scan and exceeded its thirty-second wrapper.
final_operational.recovery: Confirm no Git process or lock remains, then split tracked cleanliness, owner-scoped untracked state, history, and equality into bounded probes.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not aggregate full-worktree untracked enumeration with lifecycle Git checks.

final_operational.failed: A read-only command combined Git status, exact head, and a broad closeout stale-label search under the default login shell and timed out.
final_operational.recovery: Audit processes and locks first, then run literal bounded probes with login-shell startup disabled.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Keep Git state and repository-text searches in separate bounded calls.

final_operational.failed: The first read-only Git-process audit inherited login-shell startup overhead and timed out before returning output.
final_operational.recovery: Repeat the bounded process audit with login-shell startup disabled; the recovered probe found no Git process.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Disable login-shell startup for short PowerShell probes.

final_operational.failed: The first read-only Git-lock audit inherited login-shell startup overhead and timed out before returning output.
final_operational.recovery: Resolve the worktree Git directory and repeat the lock audit with login-shell startup disabled; the recovered probe found no lock.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Use the resolved Git directory and disable login-shell startup for lock audits.

final_operational.failed: The first read-only exact-head probe inherited login-shell startup overhead and timed out before returning output.
final_operational.recovery: Repeat only git rev-parse HEAD with login-shell startup disabled; the recovered probe matched the immutable evidence commit.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Keep exact-head probes scalar and disable login-shell startup.

final_operational.failed: The first read-only closeout stale-label search inherited login-shell startup overhead and timed out before returning output.
final_operational.recovery: Repeat the bounded exact-file search with login-shell startup disabled.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Search one declared file at a time and disable login-shell startup.

final_operational.failed: A PowerShell display rendered valid UTF-8 wording as mojibake and the first diagnosis incorrectly classified the file content as corrupted.
final_operational.recovery: Search the exact Unicode spellings directly; the recovered check proved the source already contained valid UTF-8 and required no content rewrite.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Verify exact Unicode bytes or literal spellings before diagnosing corruption.

final_operational.failed: A read-only search containing corrupted punctuation was misparsed by PowerShell and executed no repository mutation.
final_operational.recovery: Use literal ASCII-safe patterns or bounded file reads, then inspect the intended lines directly.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Avoid passing corrupted punctuation through a quoted PowerShell pattern.

final_operational.failed: A bundled read-only phase-data probe exceeded its wrapper after returning partial output.
final_operational.recovery: Use scalar exact-key searches over the declared phase data file.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer exact-key searches to broad bundled file reads.

final_operational.failed: A read-only retained-negative register preview exceeded its wrapper after returning partial output.
final_operational.recovery: Query only the required effective and operational count keys.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Read large JSON ledgers by bounded exact-key probes.

final_operational.failed: A read-only phase-truth preview exceeded its wrapper after returning partial output.
final_operational.recovery: Query only the required focus, gate, and negative-count keys.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Use scalar phase-truth probes during lifecycle adaptation.

final_operational.failed: A read-only Method Flow preview exceeded its wrapper after returning partial output.
final_operational.recovery: Query only the top-level method and witness count keys.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not preview the full Method Flow ledger for count checks.

final_operational.failed: A combined read-only exact-key search returned exit code one because one subpattern had no match, despite other requested facts being printed.
final_operational.recovery: Treat each required key as an independent bounded assertion.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not combine optional and required rg matches in one gate.

final_operational.failed: A broad uncommitted-source patch used terminal-rendered mojibake context that did not match the valid UTF-8 file and was rejected atomically.
final_operational.recovery: Patch ASCII-stable lifecycle fields separately and leave verified Unicode content unchanged.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Avoid terminal-rendered Unicode in broad patch context.

final_operational.failed: A read-only stale-label absence probe found no stale label but exposed rg's expected no-match exit code as a failed wrapper.
final_operational.recovery: Handle rg exit code one as an explicit NO_STALE_MATCHES success state.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Normalize expected no-match searches before gating.

final_operational.failed: A repository-wide read-only git diff --check exceeded its wrapper.
final_operational.recovery: Audit process and lock state, then check the exact four uncommitted closeout source files; the bounded hygiene check passed.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Use exact-path diff hygiene before generation and commit-local hygiene later.

final_operational.failed: A follow-up read-only process probe named two already-exited Git process identifiers and returned a nonzero status.
final_operational.recovery: Query the current Git process set and normalize an empty result; the recovered audit reported no Git processes.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not gate on stale process identifiers after a timeout.
